beaches.name: Ventspils nudist beach
beaches.summary: Ventspils city zones its beach and one zone is a nudist beach. The council's binding regulations on beach use, adopted 20 June 2024 and reported by the municipal tourism office, list a nūdistu pludmale alongside the 1.2 km central beach, a surfers' beach and the stretch to the city boundary; the article gives no boundaries. The Latvian Naturist Association places it south of the Blue Flag beach, reached from boardwalk 9, and describes it as municipally recognised since about 2005.
